failure_modes.cause: Vapour pressure of DMF exceeds pump inlet pressure at T > 120°C
failure_modes.mitigation: Pressurise feed reservoir to 0.5 bar above vapour pressure

failure_modes.cause: Particulate formation or deposition in valve
failure_modes.mitigation: Install inline filter upstream of BPR

failure_modes.cause: Exothermic reaction due to unexpected side reaction
failure_modes.mitigation: Implement temperature monitoring and automatic shutdown

single_points_of_failure: BPR valve — blockage stops all flow
validation_experiments: Run blank DMF at Q=0.22206 mL/min for 60 min; monitor pressure for drift > 5%
Test BPR valve with particulate-laden solvent to assess blockage risk
Conduct thermal stability test at 120°C to ensure no exothermic side reactions
